lines.text: Cut me some slack, I'm new.

data.define: To ask someone to be less strict or critical.

example.text: Cut me some slack, I'm new.

misuse.text: Don't tell your boss 'cut me some slack' daily.

data.l1_hook: Aku baru, jadi "cut me some slack" ya.

native.tip: “cut me some slack” = beri saya kelonggaran. Contoh: “Cut me some slack, I'm new.”
native.caption:
Apa arti “cut me some slack”?

Contoh: “Cut me some slack, I'm new.” ("Cut me some slack", aku baru.)
